ratings_why.fun: Every turn asks where the news starts, who stands beside whom and what to tie, and Rats glue onto any other tribe's growth; the readability load keeps it from an 8.
ratings_why.distinct: Halving per step means bigger news buys reach, so size and position trade against each other, and ties plus Wheel of Heads turn the board into a graph; no tribe today has news with range, and that earns it over a 7.

verdict_why: The engine is right; a few cards need their rules pinned down (who gossips for Taster Wendelin, what a Huddle share is, how Ilse picks the biggest).

points.text: Taster Wendelin doesn't say where the Gossip starts: on Wendelin or on the unit that grew. That changes reach and Mill-Chimney doubling, so state it.
The Winter Huddle says each share is a hit, but Hunker and Nightshade trigger on being attacked. Say whether a share is an attack, and whether Cleave's side hits split again.
Ilse the Minute-Taker repeats the biggest Gossip, but not by what measure (A+H as printed, or after Chimney doubling) or whether the repeat triggers Hears. Both decide her value.

The Seconder's +1/+1 never leaves itself without a Chimney or the Rattenkönig, so its Hears chain dies at birth. A +2/+1 would let two Seconders echo each other within the cap, which is the chain a combo player wants.
The Thirty-Two of Altenburg does nothing next to We, the Rattenkönig. It could instead hear every Gossip on the board even outside the Knot, giving it a job on boards with gaps.

standouts.why: Mill-Chimney Voice makes small news reach one step further, so where you put it is the turn's main puzzle.
Hoarfrost Knotter's tie works for every card's touching, including Hedgerow runs, which is exactly the off-label use I hunt for.
Speaker Brotkrume turns another tribe's huge unit into the whole Knot's fight stats, a real cross-tribe payoff.

weakest.why: The Seconder's Gossip never spreads on its own, so its Hears payoff looks broken in the shop.
The Thirty-Two of Altenburg is redundant beside the other T6 Rattenkönig and only pays off in a Knot that already works.
Cold-Shed Litter is a plain token maker whose gap-filling job fades once the board is full.

flags.note: Speaker with Mill-Chimney and the Rattenkönig hands a 40/40's full stats to every unit in the fight; a deliberate high roll worth the owner's eye.
Wendelin next to an Ooze's Eat, repeated by Ilse, is one huge piece of news a turn.
Unclear whether a Huddle share counts as an attack for Hunker, Nightshade and Shield.
Supper Committee counts the sold unit's tier, but the Stray token has no tier.
